chapters.title: Meta prompts: teaching your AI manners

takeaways: Business Central exposes Copilot extension points in the System AI namespace, so developers can register their own capabilities that admins control on the Copilot and Agent Capabilities page.
Meta prompts act as standing instructions that define tone, format and guardrails, combined with low temperatures for deterministic finance outputs.
Never hard-code Azure OpenAI keys: use isolated storage and SecretText for development and Azure Key Vault in production.
hook: Copilot in Business Central is more than the canned demos, but extending it badly can break a tenant or leak API keys. This episode walks Business Central developers and admins through registering capabilities, writing meta prompts, securing Azure OpenAI keys and piloting features safely. You get a five-step checklist to try in a sandbox.
